test: is the gene x line interaction biology or the shRNA construct
log: LOOP 254 -- IS THE INTERACTION BIOLOGY, OR IS IT THE HAIRPIN?
Loop 253 measured the interaction reproducing at 0.3567 while nothing explained it.
But that split was RANDOM within each (gene, line), and those signatures share their
shRNA constructs -- median 4 per pair, at least 2 in 100% of pairs. A random split
puts the same hairpins on both sides, so 0.3567 is equally consistent with construct
signal reproducing because it is the same construct twice. Loop 253's F7 named this
and did not test it.
33,197 (gene, line) pairs from 3,801 genes
G1 IS THE RANDOM-SPLIT NUMBER REPRODUCED HERE?
random split within each (gene, line): 0.2683  (n=33,195)
loop 253's F1 on the same data: 0.3567
G1 FAIL -- 0.2683 here against 0.3567 in loop 253
G2 DOES THE INTERACTION SURVIVE A CONSTRUCT SPLIT?
DISJOINT shRNA constructs, same gene, same line: 0.2487  (n=33,195)
that is 93% of the random-split value
G2 VOID -- G1 did not pass, so there is nothing here to test
G3 DOES IT SURVIVE A PLATE SPLIT?
DISJOINT plates, same gene, same line: 0.7788  (n=30,398) -- 290%
G3 VOID -- G1 did not pass, so there is nothing here to test
G4 HOW MUCH OF THE INTERACTION IS EACH? -- reported, not gated
random split    0.2683   same constructs, same plates on both sides
plate split     0.7788   290%
construct split 0.2487   93%  <- the part two hairpins agree on
the gap between the random and construct splits, 0.0196, is what
hairpin identity and batch contribute together
G5 DOES ANYTHING EXPLAIN THE PART THAT SURVIVES?
expression context against the construct-reproducible component: -0.0016
G5 VOID -- G2 did not pass, so there is nothing here to test
G6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Two hairpins against one gene can share seed families, so a construct split is a
LOWER BOUND on how much construct signal is removed, not a guarantee.
Constructs and plates are correlated by the LINCS design -- hairpins for a gene were
often run together -- so G2 and G3 overlap and neither is a clean single factor.
Both gates run on pairs with at least two constructs or plates, which is the
better-replicated subset.
If the interaction is construct, that is a fact about this ASSAY. Loop 252's E4 and
E6 stand on the raw response, not on this residual, and are unaffected.
G1  FAIL
G2  VOID
G3  VOID
G5  VOID
